verdict.rationale: Image generation and editing is a fair question for a consumer personal AI agent like Muse, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents generating or editing images from natural-language prompts. Customizing an avatar's name and style is a different feature, and the general ability to write code and build tools is only a building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can generate and edit images from natural-language prompts
